name: Santa Marina
insider_take: Perched on pristine Ornos Bay, Santa Marina transforms a legendary fishing village into Mykonos' most sophisticated waterfront sanctuary.
whats_special: This exclusive resort sits on a private peninsula where traditional Cycladic architecture meets contemporary luxury. The hotel's Buddha-Bar Beach concept creates the only beach club of its kind in the Greek islands, while the infinity pools seem to merge seamlessly with the Aegean Sea. Each suite and villa features hand-selected local artwork and private terraces overlooking the crystalline waters.
pro_tip: Book the Ammos restaurant's sunset table on the dock – it's built on stilts over the water and offers unobstructed views of Mykonos' famous golden hour without the crowds of Mykonos Town.
dont_miss: The hotel's private yacht transfers to secluded beaches and the weekly full-moon yoga sessions on the beach. Explore the nearby Psarou Beach (5 minutes away) for celebrity spotting, or take the complimentary shuttle to Mykonos Town's iconic windmills and vibrant nightlife scene.
pros: Prime beachfront location on Ornos Bay with crystal-clear waters
Elegant Cycladic architecture with stunning Aegean Sea views
Multiple dining venues including acclaimed Buddha-Bar Beach
Comprehensive spa and wellness facilities with outdoor treatments
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive Mykonos location
Can be crowded during peak summer season
